Type:
ara::core::Optional< std::uint32_t >
Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint32_t> fdf_with_sph;
Description:
std::uint32_t optional member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined fdf_with_sph
(format dependent field) 24 bit header field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype IEC68133_
IIDC. The value shall be considered, if the sph header field value is set to 1.
The value range for fdf_with_sph shall be:
0x00 00 00 00 ... 0x00 FF FF FF : valid
0x01 FF FF FF ... 0xFF FF FF FF : not used
For transmission, the value of fdf_with_sph shall be set to the configured value, if it is not
provided by the application.
Visibility:
protected
⌋
